data.title: 因幡巡 · 晨光微曦的落肩白衬衫
data.description: 清晨刚从浴室走出，巡身上套着明显大了一号的纯白衬衫。宽大的衣领自然滑落在一侧肩头，露出白皙小巧的锁骨。她手拿着毛巾慢慢擦拭着湿漉漉的发梢，迎着厨房飘来的热咖啡香气侧过头，眼眸里漾着纯粹的依恋与微红的耳尖。
data.action: wiping wet hair with towel, shoulder exposed, blushing ear
data.promptProse: Walking out of the bathroom into the bright morning corridor, Inaba Meguru wears an oversized white collared shirt slipping off one shoulder. She gently rubs her damp orange hair with a towel, blushing cutely as she glances toward the viewer.
data.animaCaption: Meguru dries her damp hair with a towel in the morning light.
